subject: EIR Request - Historic Water Supply Records for Great House Farm, Llandough (Mary Williams/Buckler, 1950s-1990s)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear EIR Team,

Under the Environmental Information Regulations, please provide all records
of water supply applications, connections, refusals, correspondence, or
service issues for Great House Farm, Llandough (near Penarth/Cardiff),
particularly involving my late gran Mary Williams or our Buckler family in
the 1900s-1980s. Include any notes on dairy operations, health impacts, or
estate disputes (Western Ground Rents/Bute).

This supports family historical research into occupation and equitable
title claims tied to a Daniel Thomas quarry deal. Thank you.


Regards,


Sion Buckler Ret'd Sergeant
